meta.name: the sun
meta.coordinate_frame: sun centre = (0,0), millimetres, y-up (positive y = up when facing the sun)
meta.led: OPSCO SKC6812RGBW 5050 RGBW, 5 V, order-on-wire GRBW (confirm at first light)

boards.A: disc Ø448, 173 px, centre pixel first, mirrored serpentine spirals outward
boards.B: inner wedge 30°, r226-674, 109 px, inner row first, serpentine row-to-row
boards.C: outer wedge 30°, r676-854, 78 px, inner row first, serpentine row-to-row

meta.sector_convention: sector k (1-12) spans sun angles 60+30(k-1) to 90+30(k-1) deg; Bk and Ck live in sector k; East PSU = sectors 1-6, West = 7-12, centre PSU = A + controller
meta.controller: PixLite E4-S Mk3, EXPANDED mode: 8 data-only runs, 3 universes per run, 128 RGBW px per universe (512 ch)
meta.sacn: universe = meta.runs[run].universes[floor(run_index/128)], start channel = 1+4*(run_index%128), RGBW = 4 consecutive channels
meta.ddp: byte offset = 4*i with runs concatenated in run order 1..8 (matches sequential universe assignment; verify against PixLite config at first light)
meta.pixel_fields: i global index in output order · run 1-8 · ri index within run · uni/ch sACN address · board · bi index within board (LED1=0) · x,y mm · r mm · th deg CCW from +x
